outline: 本課程之目標為增進研究生之英文表達能力。
schedule:
01. Introduction
02. Writing 1: Being Precise
03. Writing 2: Being Clear
04. Writing 3: Being Forthright
05. Writing 4: Being Familiar
06. Writing 5: Being Concise
07. Writing 6: Being Fluid
08. Essay Critique
09. Critical error 1, 2: Giving the wrong speech & Drawing words from the wrong well
10. Critical error 3: Leaving the audience at the dock
11. Critical error 4: Losing the audience at sea
12. Critical error 5: Projecting slides that no one reads
13. Critical error 6: Projecting slides that no one remembers
14. Critical error 7: Ignoring Murphy's Law
15. Critical error 8: Not preparing enough
16. Critical error 9: Not paying attention
17. Critical error 10: Losing composure
18. Presentation
assessment:
Portrait: 10%
Abstract or Technical Essay: 30%
Presentation: 40%
Participation/PowerPoint Tricks: 20%
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

使用外文原文書：

Books by Michael Alley, publisher: Springer Verlag
1. The craft of scientific presentation – Critical Steps to Succeed and Critical Errors to Avoid
2. The craft of scientific writing
